description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It manages routing, theming, and layout, including a placeholder for authentication and protected routes. The App component uses React Router for navigation, supports theme toggling, and renders core pages like Dashboard and AdminPage.

classes.name: NoOpProtected
classes.description: A component that wraps its children without applying any authentication or protection, effectively acting as a public route wrapper.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: The main shell component managing theme state and routing, defining the structure of the application's layout.

methods.name: NoOpProtected({ children })
methods.description: Renders children directly, acting as a placeholder for protected routes.

methods.name: AppShell()
methods.description: Defines theme toggling and the routing structure for the app.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches the theme state between 'light' and 'dark'.
